gap.CITY_WITHOUT_REGION: destination without a registered freight zone
gap.DRIVER_RATE_MISSING_FOR_CLASS: the zone has no price for this vehicle class — check the Regions tab
gap.DRIVER_ZONE_NOT_COVERED: the driver does not cover the destination zone — fix it on the driver record
gap.DRIVER_ZONE_PRICED_FROM_TABLE: table price: the driver does not have this zone — add it to the driver record
gap.DRIVER_ROUTE_AMBIGUOUS: tied routes: the trip cities match more than one route of the table equally — choose which one applies
gap.DRIVER_ROUTE_TIE_HIGHEST_RATE: routes tied on the number of trip cities — the highest price among the matching bands was used
gap.ICMS_CST_UNSUPPORTED: the emission profile uses CST 60, which the product does not issue
gap.NO_EMISSION_PROFILE: no emission profile governs the invoice (none matches, or two tie) — check the CT-e profiles
gap.NO_FREIGHT_RULE: no freight rule for the invoice — no projected revenue
gap.NO_FUEL_BASELINE: vehicle average consumption yields no cost
gap.NO_FUEL_CONSUMPTION: vehicle has no average consumption on file
gap.NO_FUEL_PRICE: no price for this vehicle's fuel
gap.SALARIED_CREW_MEMBER: a salaried driver is on this trip — cost of the period
gap.TOLL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_SUGGESTION: toll is only computed once the trip exists
gap.TOLL_PARTIAL: a toll plaza on the route has no known tariff — the total only sums the others

driverBasis.fixed: In-house driver: the cost belongs to the period, not to the trip
driverBasis.route_table: Zone {{zone}} ({{city}}) · {{vehicleClass}} · paid once for the trip, by the farthest destination zone

ledger.icmsBasis: Projected from the emission profile: CST {{cst}} · rate {{rate}} · base reduction {{reduction}} — the authorized CT-e replaces this figure
ledger.fuelBasis: {{consumption}} km/l × {{price}} per litre · {{litres}} litres on the route
ledger.incomplete: Incomplete account: the total is lower than the trip costs, and the parcels without a value stay in the list with the reason in place of the number.
ledger.taxNote: Tax comes off revenue — it is not a cost of driving, so it does not mix with the operation above.

panel.expectedGaps: Missing parameters for {{reasons}} — the total is lower than the trip costs.
panel.notFrozen: The account is frozen when the trip closes. While it is open, what exists is the forecast.
panel.operationalNote: Operational margin: it deducts freight taxes, not payroll or accounting results.
panel.partialRevenue: Revenue from {{measured}} of {{expected}} invoices — this is not final.
panel.title: This trip's account
panel.unknownParcels_one: {{count}} parcel without data: the total is approximate.
panel.unknownParcels_other: {{count}} parcels without data: the total is approximate.

workspace.noPayroll: No salaried driver in the fleet: there is no payroll to deduct for this period.
workspace.payroll: Payroll deducted from the total: BRL {{amount}}
